mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are Annam Software – a 100 % foreign-owned product house building the next-generation Omnicasa property CRM for the European market. Our legacy web (Vue 2) and Windows desktop apps still serve 3000+ agents, but we’re rebuilding everything. To move fast and smart we need a Product Manager who lives inside PostHog, turns events into insights, and tells us exactly which features make the cut for MVP-1. If you love SQL, funnels, cohorts, and saying “let the data decide”, read on.
 
Salary up to 100 million VND
yeu_cau:
What you will own
PostHog end-to-end: architect taxonomy, instrument events, set up feature flags, create dashboards, build cohorts, own data quality.
Define North-Star metric and 3–5 key drivers for the new CRM; review weekly with execs.
Run weekly growth experiments: hypothesis → PostHog A/B → readout → ship/roll-back.
Lead migration roadmap: audit legacy apps, map user flows, prioritise must-have vs nice-to-have features for the new front-end
Write concise PRDs with clear success metrics (measurable in PostHog).
Collaborate with different teams (FE, BE, QA, Design, Customer Success) in Linear + Confluence; run sprints, groom backlogs, cut scope ruthlessly.
Talk to EU agents, summarise pain points, feed into backlog.
Present data-backed recommendations to stakeholders.
What you must bring
4 + years as a SaaS product manager or growth PM; B2B CRM / Prop-Tech experience is a big plus.
Expert-level PostHog skills: events, autocapture, feature flags, SQL insights, cohorts, experiments.
Proven record of moving legacy products to modern stacks while protecting revenue.
Experience writing perfect and understandable documentation for your product
Comfortable writing basic SQL and reading JSON API payloads.
Agile native: user stories, story mapping, OKRs, Scrum/Kanban.
Excellent English (speak & write);
Nice to have
Experience with Tauri / Electron desktop migration.
Working knowledge of Node, REST & GraphQL to mock quick fixes.
UX eye – can whip up a quick Figma wireframe when designers are busy.
